record.intro: Sit facing the camera in good light, somewhere quiet. Read the script below at your normal pace. About 2 minutes works best.
record.onlyYou: Record only yourself. The person on camera must also record the consent statement.
record.maxReached: Recording stopped at the 10 minute limit.
record.script: Hi, I'm recording this so my digital twin can speak just like me. I'm going to talk naturally, the way I would to a friend. Today I want to share a few things I care about. First, why I make content at all: I like turning ideas into something people can see and use. Second, how I work: I start with a rough idea, test it quickly, and keep what works. Third, what I'd tell someone starting out: pick one thing, do it every day, and be patient. Now a few sounds for range. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. She sells seashells by the seashore. Really? Yes, really! That's amazing. Hmm, let me think about that for a second. Okay, here's the plan for this week: Monday we plan, Tuesday we film, Wednesday we edit, and Thursday we publish. Thanks for watching, and I'll see you in the next one.
